scope: Proposition 14.4 (Asymmetric capped-link estimate) of the manuscript “Strict convexity and differentiability of the planar exponential first-passage limit shape” (preprints/Strict-convexity-and-differentiability-of-the-planar-exponential-first-passage-limit-shape-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 212 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7cc30ddbfd4419f1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 76. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each fixed 0 < M < ∞ and ζ > 0, there are 1 ≤ J < ∞, fixed geometric tolerances and n0 such that, for every admissible n ≥ n0, EfJ,M (X/β) ≤ ζ. (14.20) The tolerances can be imposed by taking the rational v, w sufficiently close to the endpoints of the flat. The choices are uniform over input road laws satisfying the stated local estimates and the sublinear upper bound for β.
